description: Are Visitor Type and Purchase Independent?; published open data from the UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset.
observation_unit: One browsing session on an online retailer's website. The source has no visitor identifier, so one person can contribute several sessions.
source: Published open data: Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset (Sakar and Kastro 2018), UCI Machine Learning Repository; CC BY 4.0.

citation.dataset: Sakar, C., & Kastro, Y. (2018). Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5F88Q
citation.article: Sakar, C. O., Polat, S. O., Katircioglu, M., & Kastro, Y. (2019). Real-time prediction of online shoppers' purchasing intention using multilayer perceptron and LSTM recurrent neural networks. Neural Computing and Applications, 31(10), 6893-6908. https://doi.org/10.1007/s00521-018-3523-0

retrieved.version: UCI record last updated 2024-01-11; archive SHA-256 2972e6184d3ad7beaaa831d9fc2b059dc3ee29df69d1ec593c466a5cd8485d14.

filters: All 12,330 sessions are kept in file order, including 125 rows that repeat another row exactly; session numbers them 1-12,330 because the source has no session identifier.
VisitorType and Month keep the publisher's labels; Month has ten values (no January or April) and spells June in full.
Revenue is the publisher's TRUE/FALSE value coded 1/0.
The other 14 columns are left out.

columns.name: session
columns.description: Session number in the publisher's file order

columns.name: VisitorType
columns.description: Visitor type recorded by the retailer's analytics

columns.name: Month
columns.unit: Feb, Mar, May, June, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov or Dec
